title: Pooled Library Amplification
author: Addgene The Nonprofit Plasmid Repository
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba79ihr6
materials: Electroporate cells (one at a time for a total of eight electroporations): Electroporator Conditions: Bio-Rad Micropulser Ec1 0.1 cm cuvette, 1.8 kV, 1 pulse.
Aliquot 25 µL DNA-Endura into pre-chilled cuvette.
Immediately add 1 mL SOC to cuvette.
Use one scraper for all plates.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Electroporation
steps.instruction: Add 200 ng DNA to each 50 µL aliquot of thawed Endura Duos on ice and flick gently to mix.

steps.title: Electroporate Cells
steps.instruction: Pulse the cell/DNA mixture using an electroporator according to the equipment manual specifications.

steps.title: Recover Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell/DNA mixture from the cuvette into SOC medium using vented Falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Remove all liquid from the cuvette and add to a 14 mL vented Falcon Tube containing 3 mL SOC.
Repeat for each of the 25 µL aliquots used (8 in the described protocol), using a new vented falcon tube for every two transformations.
Ensure each of the four 14 mL vented falcon tubes contains a total of 5 mL (3 mL SOC + 2 mL transformed Endura from two separate transformations).
Avoid repeated pipetting or mixing when removing the SOC containing transformed DNA-Endura from the cuvette.

steps.title: Incubate and Pool Cells
steps.instruction: Shake the transformed cells and pool them after incubation.

substeps.instruction: Shake four 14 mL Vented Falcon Tubes at 30 °C - 37 °C, 225 rpm, for 01:00:00.
After the 1 hour shaking period, pool and gently mix the four tubes.

steps.title: Determine Colony Yield
steps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions and plate the cells to calculate the total colony yield.

substeps.instruction: Perform sequential 1:100 dilutions of the cells (add 10 µL of the pool to 990 µL LB, then perform a second and then third 1:100 dilution).
Plate 100 µL of each dilution onto a prewarmed Petri dish.
Incubate plates at 30 °C overnight.
Count colonies on the most dilute Petri dish and calculate total colony yield: count x 100 x 100 x 100 ÷ 0.1.
Verify that the yield is at least 1000x greater than the number of perturbations in the library (e.g., at least 10 colonies on the most diluted plate for 100,000 plasmids).

steps.title: Plate Transformed Cells for Bioassay
steps.instruction: Distribute transformed cells onto bioassay plates and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Plate 2.5 mL of the transformed cells on each of the eight bioassay plates (two plates per tube).
Distribute evenly with a sterile spreader until all liquid is absorbed (usually 00:01:00 - 00:02:00), using gentle spreading to avoid ripping the agar.
Incubate plates upside down at 30 °C overnight, ensuring no unabsorbed media drips onto the lid.

steps.title: Prepare for Cell Harvesting
steps.instruction: Prepare necessary materials and reagents for harvesting bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Place 100 mL sterile LB at 4 °C.
Prechill at least four conical tubes on ice (prepare 1-2 extra tubes if needed).
Ensure access to a sterile scraper and cold LB.

steps.title: Harvest Bacteria from Plates
steps.instruction: Scrape bacteria from bioassay plates after growth using cold LB.

substeps.instruction: After 12:00:00 - 18:00:00 of growth, use a spreader and cold LB to scrape bacteria from the plates.
Use two 10 mL pipettes: one for dispensing cold LB and one for removing LB containing bacteria.
Add 10 mL cold LB to each plate for each scrape; use a pushing motion with the spreader to avoid gouging the agar.
Add each scrape into a 50 mL conical tube on ice, pooling the scrapings of two plates into each tube.
Repeat the 10 mL cold LB addition and scraping for each plate until the agar is clear, producing 25 mL cold LB-bacteria per plate.

steps.title: Pellet and Weigh Bacteria
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the harvested cells and determine the pellet weight.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 4000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes to pellet bacteria.
Decant LB and weigh the pellet (expected weight: ~ 1 g - 2 g). Weigh the empty tube beforehand or an identical empty tube for accuracy.

steps.title: Purify and Quantify Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Extract plasmid DNA and measure the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Immediately purify plasmid DNA using the Qiagen HiSpeed Maxi Kit (one conical tube per Maxiprep); do not freeze pellets before purification.
Quantify individual Maxipreps using Nanodrop, Picogreen, or Qubit.

steps.title: Pool DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Pool the Maxiprep samples if sufficient DNA is present.

substeps.instruction: If all Maxipreps contain sufficient DNA (typically ranging from several hundred micrograms to a milligram of total plasmid DNA), pool the samples and proceed with analysis.
